meta.purpose: Everything that could not be confirmed against an official source, plus every irregularity found while verifying line by line. These items are published deliberately, with source links, so they can be reviewed after the site is live. They do not block publication.
meta.counting_rule: An item is 'unverified' if a value is required for the decision but no official source could confirm it in this session. It is left blank in the data, never filled with an estimate.

irregularities.title: The parcel is not identified anywhere in the repository or the brief
irregularities.detail: The brief says 'around central los Angeles' but supplies no address, APN or coordinates. Privacy rules forbid publishing them, but they are also simply absent. Every parcel-level deliverable — tract census, flood zone, fire severity zone, traffic count, competitive ring — therefore cannot be completed, only prepared.
irregularities.impact: W-01 and W-04 are structurally blocked at the parcel level. The site publishes the method and the reference-point proof instead of the parcel answer.
irregularities.action_requested: Supply the location in the secure workspace. Do not send it through chat and do not commit it.

irregularities.title: The lease expiration is stated as an eight-year window (2030-2035)
irregularities.detail: An eight-year window is not a term. A 2030 expiration with no options and a 2031 expiration with two five-year options are different assets, priced differently. No public source — including the tenant's SEC filings — discloses per-store lease expiration dates at this granularity, so the window could not be externally verified either.
irregularities.impact: The single largest driver of value in this project is unresolved. The site refuses to price the asset until it is fixed.
irregularities.action_requested: Provide the executed lease or state the four calendar dates directly.

irregularities.title: The brief mixes two different decision makers
irregularities.detail: It asks for the best decision 'for the property and myself as an individual'. Those can conflict. The property-optimal answer might be 'hold for the rent', while the owner-optimal answer might be 'sell to reduce concentration'. Resolving that requires private net-worth and liquidity data that cannot appear on a public site.
irregularities.impact: The site separates the two: it can describe the property arithmetic, but the portfolio-fit judgement is flagged as an adviser conversation.
irregularities.action_requested: Confirm which framing has priority, or treat both as constraints.

irregularities.title: The Census data API rejected every keyless request
irregularities.detail: Requests to api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5 returned a 'Missing Key' page. A free key is required. This blocked the tract-level pull that W-01 depends on.
irregularities.impact: No tract-level demographic figures could be retrieved this session. All city-level figures are marked as failing the trade-area test rather than being passed off as trade-area numbers.
irregularities.action_requested: Register a key and re-run the documented query in data/tradearea.json.

irregularities.title: The CAL FIRE LRA 2025 feature service returned an empty result at the reference point
irregularities.detail: The query succeeded but returned zero features. An empty result is consistent with 'not in a zoned area' but is not an official determination. It was recorded as unverified rather than interpreted as 'no fire hazard'.
irregularities.impact: Fire zone status remains unknown even at the reference point. Interpreting an empty response as 'safe' would be exactly the kind of inference the owner prohibited.
irregularities.action_requested: Confirm on the official OSFM address viewer.

irregularities.title: RESOLVED (2026-11-26): California FTB 2026 PIT rate schedules verified
irregularities.detail: Earlier session could not load the 2025 540 booklet. On 2026-11-26, FTB Tax News October 2026 (S-033) and FTB Form 5805F Instructions (S-034) verified the full 2026 Schedules X/Y/Z (1.00% to 12.30%) and the +1.00% Mental Health Services Act tax over $1,000,000. Only the owner's personal taxable-income tier remains private.
irregularities.impact: The browser calculator now offers both verified 2026 FTB progressive brackets and a custom marginal rate override.
irregularities.action_requested: Confirm personal filing status and other taxable income privately in the browser calculator.

irregularities.title: RESOLVED (2026-11-26) WITH GEOGRAPHIC CAVEAT: LA County QuickFacts V2025 verified
irregularities.detail: County QuickFacts now verified at 9,694,934 (July 1, 2025, -3.2% since 2020, S-023) alongside CA DOF E-1 (-64,000 YoY to Jan 1, 2026, S-024). Still fails as a trade-area proxy because the county is 4,059 sq mi.
irregularities.impact: County context is now verified alongside city figures, both clearly marked as non-trade-area benchmarks.
irregularities.action_requested: Pull census-tract figures via ACS API once G-01 and G-02 close.

irregularities.title: Metro HPI series choice: 31084 (MSA) rather than 31080 (metropolitan division)
irregularities.detail: The first attempt at ATNHPIUS31080Q failed to fetch. The FHFA series that loaded was ATNHPIUS31084Q, the Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim MSA. The two are different geographies.
irregularities.impact: Every HPI figure in this project is the MSA. Nothing was relabelled as the division. The back-test result is therefore metro-wide, which is stated in the model's limitations.
irregularities.action_requested: Confirm the MSA is the intended geography, or re-pull the division series.

irregularities.title: CPI 12-month change is printed for September, not October
irregularities.detail: The BLS Economy at a Glance table lists the October 2026 CPI index value (360.965) but the 12-month change column stops at September (3.7%). The October change was not printed.
irregularities.impact: The site shows the September change and says so, rather than computing an October change from an index into which a base-period assumption would have to be introduced.
irregularities.action_requested: None — this is a disclosure, not an error.

irregularities.title: No cap rate, rent, basis or insurance figure exists anywhere in this repository
irregularities.detail: Six named quote slots (Q-01 to Q-06) and all sell-side and hold-side inputs are null. There is no official federal, state or county source for single-tenant QSR cap rates, and no broker quotes were obtained.
irregularities.impact: W-02 and the after-tax module are delivered as a verified METHOD with a working browser calculator, not as a computed comparison. Any published verdict would have required inventing a cap rate.
irregularities.action_requested: Engage brokers and an appraiser, and supply basis and insurance documents privately.

irregularities.title: Hazard screening used a downtown reference point, not the parcel
irregularities.detail: All three hazard queries were run at 34.0522 / -118.2437 to prove the method and capture genuine official responses. Those values are labelled reference-only in every row.
irregularities.impact: The dashboard shows real USGS and FEMA output, clearly stamped as not the parcel. This demonstrates capability without pretending to have the answer.
irregularities.action_requested: Re-run the three prepared queries with the parcel coordinates.

irregularities.title: Tenant identity is public, owner identity is not in this repository
irregularities.detail: Jack in the Box Inc. is an SEC registrant, so its filings are legitimately public and are cited. The franchisee entity and the owner are private and appear nowhere. No public record in this repo can link the parcel to a person.
irregularities.impact: Confirms the privacy model held: the site names a public corporate brand and nothing else.

irregularities.title: Two different official Los Angeles population figures appear across the repo's parallel trees
irregularities.detail: A parallel session recorded LA city population as 3,878,704 from Census Vintage 2024 release CB25-77. This tree records 3,869,089 from QuickFacts V2025 (a July 1, 2025 estimate). Both are official; they are different vintages and are not comparable. The same pattern applies to unemployment: 5.9% is LA County not-seasonally-adjusted for September 2025 (EDD), while 4.6% is the LA-Long Beach-Glendale metropolitan division for October 2026 (BLS).
irregularities.impact: A reader comparing the two trees could conclude one is wrong. Neither is. Every figure in this tree states its geography and period, and the Census Bureau itself warns that different vintage years are not comparable.
irregularities.action_requested: When a single figure is chosen for any external use, cite the vintage with it. Do not average or blend vintages.

irregularities.title: No Q4 / FY2026 Jack in the Box Form 10-K or earnings release found on SEC EDGAR as of 2026-11-26
irregularities.detail: EDGAR holds Q1, Q2 and Q3 FY2026 releases and Form 10-Q through July 5, 2026 (S-037 to S-041), but no Q4/FY2026 filing appeared on EDGAR as of 2026-11-26 (prior year Q4 FY2025 was filed 2025-11-19).
irregularities.impact: Tenant operating series stops at Q3 FY2026 (ended July 5, 2026). Full-year FY2026 unit count and franchise rental totals remain pending.
irregularities.action_requested: Check SEC EDGAR CIK 0000807882 for the FY2026 10-K before finalising renewal negotiations.

irregularities.title: Back-test scope boundary: macro HPI is back-tested; parcel-level cash-flow model is NOT back-tested
irregularities.detail: Across sibling trees (F-20), the FHFA MSA HPI mean-reversion rule has 7 overlapping back-test pairs (r = -0.937), whereas the parcel-level NNN cash-flow model has zero verified rent, cap-rate or historical comp inputs and therefore cannot be back-tested.
irregularities.impact: Readers must not mistake the macro HPI back-test for a validated parcel valuation model.
irregularities.action_requested: Keep model status as v0.1-unbacktested-core until G-04, G-05 and G-06 close.
